goal: Separate current task-relation recognition errors from action-consequence errors, including held identity, drawer membership/state, actual success/refusal and non-target movement
data: Existing core1200_v1, fixed A/B train40 validation10 test10; same 3 branches x4 actions; no collection; no C/D
visual_models: Two frozen roots40 joint RSSMs; reuse cached current/one_step/free1..4 predictions. Test includes existing h2 supplement; no encoder forward or RSSM fit

truth_inputs.relations: held red/blue/pink + in-drawer red/blue/pink + drawer3 onehot, plus7 known flags
truth_inputs.physics_enriched: same relation state plus before-only object xyz/quaternion/linear/angular velocities, robot proprioception, door/button/switch/light scalars, contact summaries, static scene surface coordinates

physics_limit: Enriched recorded boundary state, not proven complete Markov state: robot joint velocities, controller internal/collision-solver state not recorded. Do not label remaining errors as dynamics inability.
architecture: Identical padded input dimension and parameter count: initial Linear->SiLU->Linear(128), GRUCell(action7,128), Linear128->SiLU->Linear15; relation arm zeros all physical dimensions. Output H3,I3,drawer3,status3,moved3.
loss: Equal .5 teacher-reset one-step and .5 free4; within each: (heldBCE+inBCE+drawerCE)/3 + .5 statusCE + .25 movedBCE; validity masked, no class weighting
selection: Per arm and seed select lower fixed validation objective (.5 one-step + .5 free4), tie earlier; freeze selected hashes before test. No refit/search beyond2 prespecified checkpoints.
sampling: Uniform training root then one of3 branches; seeded materialized1500x32 schedule shared arms within seed
normalization: Physical mean/std from train action-before states t0..3 only; min std .001; contacts force log1p; no future/label/status/actual-duration input
known_actions: Six declared skills one-hot plus planned budget/900, no actual success/control count/selected target oracle
extra_no_fit_control: Reuse relation model with hard visual current relations substituted for GT initial relations, same weights/action sequence; pairing measures input sensitivity within this model, not pure perception contribution in original RSSM
metrics: Per relation exact, changed-state exact, positive holding/in-drawer recall, action success Brier/recall/false-success-on-refused, non-target moved recall/FPR; root-cluster2000 intervals; strata visual initial relation correct vs wrong, actual success/refused/executed_failure
state_sufficiency: Group same before coarse relation+action and full symbolic category+action; count conflicting observed successors/status on train; retain geometry-differing examples, not counterfactual causal effects
interpretation: Current only-correct relation stratum does not guarantee latent/geometry correctness. Cross-architecture score gaps are not pure sensory causal contributions. Open-loop replayed actions are not new closed-loop planning.
